observe.sheet-whole-in-frame.en: Get the whole sheet in: all four corners, every row.
observe.sheet-whole-in-frame.ha: Saka dukan takardar a hoton: kusurwoyinta huɗu duka, da kowane layi.
observe.sheet-whole-in-frame.ig: Tinye mpempe akwụkwọ ahụ dum na foto: nkuku anọ ya niile, na ahịrị ọ bụla.
observe.sheet-whole-in-frame.yo: Jẹ́ kí gbogbo ìwé náà wà nínú fọ́tò: igun mẹ́rẹ̀ẹ̀rin, àti gbogbo ìlà.

observe.sheet-other-race.en: This photo looks like the {v0} result, not {v1}. Check it is the right sheet.
observe.sheet-other-race.ha: Wannan hoton kamar sakamakon zaɓen {v0} ne, ba na {v1} ba. Ka tabbata takardar da ta dace ce.
observe.sheet-other-race.ig: Foto a dị ka nsonaazụ ntuli aka {v0}, ọ bụghị nke {v1}. Lelee na ọ bụ mpempe akwụkwọ kwesịrị ekwesị.
observe.sheet-other-race.yo: Fọ́tò yìí jọ àbájáde ìdìbò {v0}, kì í ṣe ti {v1}. Ṣàyẹ̀wò pé ìwé tó tọ́ ni.

observe.sheet-parties-not-found.en: Not found on the photo: {v0}. If part of the sheet is cut off, add the next part.
observe.sheet-parties-not-found.ha: Ba a same su a hoton ba: {v0}. Idan wani ɓangare na takardar ya yanke, ƙara kashi na gaba.
observe.sheet-parties-not-found.ig: Ahụghị ha na foto ahụ: {v0}. Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ nke mpempe akwụkwọ ahụ bịpụrụ, tinye akụkụ na-esote.
observe.sheet-parties-not-found.yo: A kò rí wọn nínú fọ́tò náà: {v0}. Bí apá kan ìwé náà bá ti gé kúrò, fi apá tó kàn kún un.
